slug: 2026-06-02 SIN, ST Digital to deploy cloud services at Lomé data center

facts.fact: Connecting Africa reports that the state-owned SIN operates the Lomé Data Centre, where SIN and ST Digital are launching private cloud services, with SIN's director saying firms can rent half or full racks for data hosting; date is the article's, as it gives no opening date.
Connecting Africa describes the SIN-operated Lomé Data Centre as a Tier III-certified facility, without naming the certifying body; date is the article's.
